account.deleteMessage: You leave the workspaces you share. A workspace only you are in stops for good, with its coworkers and its files. This cannot be undone.
account.reauthTitle: Sign in again to delete your account

account.leaveServerMessage: You will be signed out, and Rerun reopens on Rerun Cloud.

inbox.markAllMessage: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will leave this list. Requests still waiting on an answer are cleared too, without being answered.
inbox.running: {count, plural, one {# task running} other {# tasks running}}
inbox.loadFailed: We could not load your notifications.
inbox.emptyDescription: When a coworker needs you or finishes a task, it lands here.

row.label: {headline}, {detail}
row.unfollowed: You no longer follow {name}'s scheduled tasks.

_context.title: Large title of the Home: the list of the workspace's coworkers. The native launch screen draws the same word.
_context.line.workingOn: Status line under a coworker's name: it is running, {detail} is the title of its conversation or its description.
_context.line.asleepAbout: Status line under a coworker's name: its machine is off, {about} is its description.
_context.foreman.askAnything: Status line of Rerun, the workspace assistant, when it has no conversation yet.
_context.header.byBox: View option: the coworkers grouped by Box.
_context.account.subscriptionMessage: {workspaces} is a comma-separated list of workspace names.
_context.workspace.untitled: Fallback name of a workspace without a name.
_context.search.quotedAsk: The text typed in the search field, quoted, under 'Ask Rerun'.
_context.search.hitDetail: Under a conversation found by the search: the coworker's name and how long ago it was active ("5m").
_context.inbox.row.detail: Under an inbox row: the coworker's name and the conversation's title.
_context.inbox.row.read: Very short label of the swipe action that marks a row as read.
_context.section.label: VoiceOver label of a collapsible section header: its name and how many rows it holds.
_context.account.leaveServerTitle: {host} is the web address of the Rerun server the app is connected to.
_context.account.leaveServer: Destructive button of the dialog that leaves a self-hosted server.
